name: Indian Bank

guidance: On guidance, I had guided for deposit growth of 9-11%, and I am revising that to 11-12%.
We expect the total impact to be Rs.3,500 crore, so we are making the provision while times are good.
capex: Return on equity was 19.66%, an expansion of 18 basis points.
As you all know, the repo rate has been increased by 25 basis points, so we should see NIM expansion of perhaps 5-6 basis points going forward.
risks: Ashok Ajmera, Analyst On treasury front, every Bank is under pressure because of hardening yields, and you have performed comparatively better than other Banks so far.
They will be challenged, there will be a lot of discussion, and the regulator may not accept all our assumptions.
focus: Shri Binod Kumar, MD & CEO In corporate, I am targeting growth of 10 -12%.
I am not targeting 20 -25%, because that would ultimatel y affect the bottom line and underwriting quality.
